statement_notes.justification: The exact semialgebraic loading-body representation and CAD/QE already settle every fixed finite instance, including its chamber decomposition, signs, incidences, and simultaneous off-diagonal-zero locus.  The remaining mathematical object is a support-uniform closed ordered/combinatorial theorem or formula that reveals how those features vary with the ordered adoption endpoint pattern and the memory length.
statement_notes.gap: No cited source or proved result gives a support-uniform endpoint/lag classification of chamber counts and connectivity, complete sign labels, incidence posets, and simultaneous off-diagonal-zero strata across ordered absorbing supports and memory lengths.  Running generic CAD/QE separately on each finite support is exact and terminating but does not supply that structural law.
statement_notes.consumer: Such a uniform classification would tell an analyst which loading-sign regimes and exact off-diagonal-zero designs can occur from the ordered endpoint pattern and memory length before any particular finite instance is sent to CAD/QE.
